outcome: Barriers to the delivery of NCD clinical care
cohort: The study included 20 patients living with hypertension, diabetes, and/or cardiac disease from Mbarara Regional Referral Hospital and 11 healthcare providers from public health facilities in Mbarara, southwestern Uganda.
finding: Pre-existing challenges with non-communicable disease (NCD) care were exacerbated during COVID-19 lockdown periods, leading to severe disruption in care, worsened patient health, and even death.
